title: fix(plugin-grid): a link cell holds its value as text, never an anchor inside the record anchor (objectui#11817)
body:
Fixes #11817

Clause-②: no

## What the card claimed, and what measuring it found

Each claim was measured through the real list page: the real `ObjectView`, the `action:bar` → `action:button` → `ActionRunner` chain, the console action runtime, `ActionParamDialog` and the real `ConsoleToaster` (sonner not mocked), in an `en` i18next instance. The instrument is `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteFeedback-11817.test.tsx`, which re-derives every row below.

| Claim | Measured before this PR (`4e7dd56`) | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Invite User gives no success message | The declared `successMessage` ("Invitation sent") reaches the toaster after Confirm, with the served `sys_user` action shape (email, plus role through `objectOverride: 'sys_member'`). No objectui code drops it. | Pinned, with a control: a refused invite toasts the server's message and no success toast. Not reproduced in objectui; see "Not measured". |
| The Invitations grid nests an anchor inside an anchor | Reproduced. The primary-field link (the list's first column is `email`) held `EmailCellRenderer`'s `mailto:` anchor and its copy button. | Fixed in `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, below. |
| Every parameter dialog shows one generic subtitle | An action that declares `description` is subtitled with it (served `ban_user` shape). `invite_user` and `approval_approve` declare none, so the generic line is the right answer for them today. | Both halves pinned. The missing descriptions are objectstack metadata (Acceptance notes). |

## The change (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`)

A grid's link cell, meaning the first column or a column authored `link: true`, is the row's anchor to its record (objectui#4490). A value drew an anchor inside it in two ways, so there are two mechanisms:

- `email`, `url`, `phone` and the file family (`file`, `video`, `audio`) draw their own anchor without asking the host. Inside a link cell they are now drawn with their text face. `linkCellRenderer` in `cellRendererResolution.ts` narrows the renderer `resolveGridCellRendering` answered and reaches the text renderer through `gridCellRendererForFixedKey`, so that module stays the grid's one way to a renderer (objectui#8920).
- A reference (`lookup`, `master_detail`, `tree`) draws `ReferencedRecordLink` only when the host's `recordHref` answers for the referenced object. `LinkCell`'s anchor form now renders its children under the same host with `recordHref` and `openRecord` withheld, which the context documents as "cannot route there, render the plain value".

Every other column keeps its anchors, copy buttons and download links (pinned as controls). No export, prop or language-pack key is added.

The file family is in the set because the census found it. `ObjectGrid.linkCellNoNestedAnchor-11817.test.tsx` draws every type `listCellRendererTypes()` reports (a live reading of the registry) in a link column. Its control shows the probe values draw mailto, URL, tel, download and record anchors outside a link cell, so the census can fail.

## Evidence

All runs were made from the worktree root through the shared verify lock. Wall-clock figures are shared-box readings.

- **Union at `484906c`** (the head, after merging main): `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/` plus the three app-shell files that read this path (`ObjectView.inviteFeedback-11817`, `ObjectView.emptyStateMatchesPage-11687`, `ActionParamDialog`) and `useConsoleActionRuntime.paramDialogTitle`: `Test Files 193 passed (193)`, `Tests 1816 passed (1816)`.
- **Ablation** used `ablation-replace` on committed state. Each restore was proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
  - Leg 1, at `1edf68a`: the text-face substitution disabled. 7 failed and 10 passed. The failures are the four self-linking first columns, the `link: true` email column, the census and the Invitations end-to-end case.
  - Leg 2, at `27653b8`: the provider override removed. 2 failed and 8 passed: the reference-in-a-link-column case and the census. The first attempt at this leg was a no-op. The tool refused it because the replacement text already occurred twice in the file, so nothing landed. It was re-run with a unique replacement.
- **Before the fix**, a probe through the real `ObjectView` read the primary-field link's markup as the record anchor holding a `mailto:` anchor and a copy button. React's nested-anchor warning appeared in the census run before the file family joined the set. It is absent from every unmutated run since, and it came back in ablation leg 1.
- **Type-check**, at `27653b8` after building the app-shell dependency closure: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` exit 0, and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0. Both `tsconfig.test.json` include `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so both new test files are checked.
- **Lint**, `eslint` on the four touched files: 0 errors. `ObjectGrid.tsx` has 207 warnings, the same count as at base (measured on the base file). The two new test files have 0.
- **Gates**, all exit 0 at `484906c`: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps` and `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.

## Not measured

- **Real browser.** No showcase backend could be reached from this container (the objectstack checkout here is unbuilt). The toast and the anchor are pinned through the real components in happy-dom instead.
- **The toast in the reporter's browser.** Why the reporter's browser pass saw no toast is not reproduced or explained here. Through the real chain the toast renders in the toaster's DOM. One candidate, not measured: sonner's default lifetime is 4s, shorter than a snapshot taken a turn after Confirm.
- **The app-shell suite.** The full `packages/app-shell/` suite was not run locally and is left to CI. This PR adds one test file there and changes no app-shell source.

## Acceptance notes

- **Naming the invitee is metadata.** The runner already fills `${result.*}` from the answer (objectui#11344), and the pin above shows copy reading `${result.email}` toasting "Invitation sent to ada@example.com". The `invite_user` entries in objectstack (`sys_user`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member`; `successMessage: 'Invitation sent'`) and their generated translation bundles name nobody. The bundle entry wins over the authored literal, so both would change. That the live invite-member answer carries `email` was read from the route ledger (better-auth sourced), not measured.
- **The missing subtitles are metadata.** `invite_user` (the same three objects) and `approval_approve` in `plugin-approvals`' `sys-approval-request.object.ts` declare no `description`. `approval_reject` beside it does.
- **Bounds of this fix, not measured on any shipped list:**
  - A rich-text value (`markdown`, `html`) whose content contains a link, drawn in a link column, still nests that link.
  - An image cell's "+N" button inside a link column is a button inside an anchor. React does not warn on it.
- **Read-only inference, not measured.** `paramCollectionHandler` in `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` lists neither `actionDescription` nor `language` among its `useCallback` dependencies.
